run_Subprocess: run a command in a subprocess and capture stdout and stderr output with exit code
set_SetEnvVar: set or unset an environment variable to a given value in the test environment
get_GetTestExecutablePath: get the absolute path of a test binary given its name and build directory
get_GetExitStatus: get the exit status code from the result of os.system command
run_Main: run the unit test suite after parsing and stripping Google Test flags from argv
